briefs.name: Departures, Signalled
briefs.hypothesis: Platformed already wins the lenses that measure use: interaction and usability 8.5, type 8, 0 small targets, the clearest sight line on the landing panel. It lost points on three things: soul (7), style (7) and skeptic (6.3). (1) Costume enamel: the teal, denim and plum-filled starter plates are 12% other-neon, the highest of the finals, and every lens called the plum muddy. (2) Light only in the corner: 'plan' has little halo, and the board is the only tube. (3) Inner pages read as a generic dark dashboard, because the line stops at Home, To do and the forms. This cross makes three changes. The starters become neutral slate keys with a 3px destination stub. Her question gets the original's layered halo and a pool lit from below. The station's two signature devices, the line with ring stops and the lit board, go onto every inner page, using the main camp's best structures: Joined's contents rail and spend dial, Quote Board's page figure, and Backlit Plate's four-week trace. That should lift soul, style, system and skeptic by about a point each, with no cost to the usability lead. It also meets the owner's ask: bright green where the motif needs it (the question, the board, the dial, the lamps), and matte slate, bone and steel everywhere else.
briefs.brief: KEEP, recognisable at a glance: Vera's line down the left of Home as the widest column, first in the source (her screen, the box as the first stop, the ways to start as interchanges, the lit 'Continue with Vera' terminus). Also keep the dot-matrix departures board beside the box, the 'usually Plans / To do / Ideas' hints, the To do page's margin times with the lit Now ring, the timetable Chat with the denim-edged family plates, Archivo, the slate/bone/steel tokens and the 0-small-target discipline. HOME (templates/home.html, _ask.html, sheet.css 'Home: the concourse' ~1424-1800). 1. Title: 'Give Vera something to plan.' Put the full stop in the same text node right after , with no whitespace, so it is ink and never glows. Set it in Archivo 600 at wdth 112, 2.75rem/1.0, tracking -0.015em, with a true curly apostrophe anywhere one appears. 'plan' carries the full E1 lit-word halo from phosphor_kit.md: a tight bloom inside a wide one, exact #6dff9c. 2. The question's plate (.home-line .ask-plate, sheet.css ~1462) gets the pool from below through scanlines. It is the Dessau .welcome::before grafted onto the plate: a radial 16-18% #6dff9c core centred under 'plan', and a second pool at the lower left. Both are seen through 1px-in-4px scanlines, masked by a wide radial and clipped to the plate. The plate's bottom edge is the platform sill: border-bottom at 38% green, the other edges at 14%, and a spill of 0 24px 40px -30px rgb(109 255 156/.35) onto the page below (ledger L099). Drop the spill under prefers-contrast:more. 3. Ways to start (.starters, sheet.css ~1518-1570): remove the enamel faces entirely. Each key becomes one shared slate plate (var(--surface-2), 1px var(--card-edge)) on its steel spur. The only colour is a 3px stub where the spur meets the plate, in the destination's colour. The 'usually …' hint is led by that page's own icon (calendar, checklist, bulb) at 1rem, in var(--label) 400 at the same size as the starter, not smaller. Retune the section tokens toward lower chroma and period hues: --plans #8fb6d8 (signal blue), --todo #86c4b4 (verdigris), and --ideas from plum #b694d5 to #c9b48f (sand, chroma below .06). Amber stays for late alone. Squint-check sand against amber. 4. The board (.departures, sheet.css ~1658): fed at its head by a lit wire. A 2px phosphor wire leaves her rail level with the box's ring and runs across the gutter into the board's NEXT UP tab (ledger L030 / the lineage's own t3-timetable-graft wire). The rail is lit only from the box's ring to that wire. Above and below it the rail is steel var(--edge) at 1.5px, so the line is lit only from now to next, never along its whole length. Board rows are VT323 at 1.2rem, with tabular dates right-aligned in a fixed column and dotted phosphor leaders at 34%. Each row is a whole of at least 44px to its plan. Give the case the E12 spill and power light, and the glass E13/E14 bloom and scanlines at screenGlow 1.0. 5. FOUR-WEEK TRACE (graft, below). It forms the board's foot inside the same glass. 6. The right column hangs from the line. Coming up's board, then Lately added and the kids' wishes, become branch stops: a steel branch rail drops from the board's case along the column's left edge, with a 10px steel ring at each section head. Lately added stays matte. Its kind pictogram sits in a ring of the kind's colour, and the kind word at the right takes that colour at 70% into ink, so it no longer reads as a table of contents. Only the board is lit in this column. 7. Setup: delete the amber-left-bar notice plate. Setup becomes a stop on her line just after the terminus: an amber ring (not a lamp) on the rail, 'Finish setting up · 3 steps' in the sign face, and the next step as one underlined line, with 'See all' at the right. Its Tab order follows the terminus, as it is drawn. 8. Phone (max-width 40rem): order is the title, the box, then the board directly under the box (fed by the wire turned 90 degrees down the rail), then the starters, the terminus, setup, To do and the rest. PAGE HEADS, every inner page (_ui.html page_head, sheet.css 'The top of a page' ~572-625): graft QUOTE FIGURE (below). The line's roundel hangs in the margin, then the title in Archivo 600 wdth 100 at 2.5rem. Then the page's figure on the same baseline in bone var(--heading) at wdth 75, 500 weight, 2.5rem. Then a stacked mono unit and change line: unit in Plex Mono 500 .75rem caps, tracked .07em, var(--label); under it the change, where late is an amber link to the filtered list. The figures are: To do '4 OPEN / ▸ 3 late'; Plans '5 AHEAD / next Sun 4 Oct 13:00'; Ideas '12 IDEAS / 10 on the radar'; Status '5 WORKING / ▸ 1 needs a look'; Settings '9 PARTS / ▸ 1 needs a look'. Under the head, a 1.5px steel rule with a 2px cap in the section's colour runs 3rem from the roundel: her line's stub on every page. PLANS (plans.html, plans_month.html): the departures board becomes the Plans header (system's ask). It is a full-width cased board above the month grid: NEXT UP with the next plan large, the next three on leaders, and the four-week trace as its foot. Month cells keep matte slate. Today is a steel outline with a lit lamp, and plan chips get a 2px left stub in --plans. Fix the chip truncation with line-clamp at 2 lines. TO DO (tasks.html): keep the margin times and the Now ring. Add a 'Late 3' latched key, amber words, beside Open/Done/Cancelled/All (Figure Ground's filter, as usability asked). The key row is one segmented control with an inset well and a lit 2px LED on the latched key. IDEAS (ideas.html): the line runs down the table's left edge. Each row's kind ring is a stop on a steel rail. The radar tube's caption ('North at the top…') moves inside the board's case as its engraved legend strip. The Kind filter stays a real select. On the new-idea form the Kind field becomes an input with a datalist and no chevron, its value in ink and the placeholder in italic var(--faint). STATUS (status.html): graft STATUS BOARD (below). Rows use a fixed 14rem label column, with value and note beside the label, not flush right (usability). The legend line (Working, Not set up, Needs a look) stays as it is. SETTINGS (settings.html): the directory hangs on the same steel rail with ring stops, ending at Setup. Values sit in the 14rem label grid, and the page figure is '9 PARTS'. TYPE SYSTEM, written into :root as tokens: --t-legend .75rem (Plex Mono caps, tracking .07em, glass and legends only); --t-small .875rem; --t-body 1rem/1.55 Archivo 400; --t-item 1.0625rem 500; --t-sign 1.375rem Archivo 600 wdth 100 (section heads); --t-title 2.5rem 600; --t-ask 2.75rem 600 wdth 112. Labels never sit in a weaker grey than var(--label) #a7b2b8. Tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) go on every time, count and date column. Notes and ledes are capped at 62ch.
briefs.borrows:
Own judges' most-cited fixes:
(a) Neutral starter plates with a destination stub and page icon instead of tinted enamel faces. Asked for by all eight lenses on the landing panel: feedback, soul, style, system, interaction, type, usability and skeptic. Swapping the plum for a period hue was feedback's and skeptic's ask in tour r3.
(b) Carry Vera's line to the right column and to the Ideas, Plans, Status and Settings heads. Asked for by feedback, style, system and skeptic on the landing panel, and by feedback in r3.
(c) The layered E1 halo on 'plan' and more halo and scale on the board: soul and style on the landing panel, feedback.
(d) Board rows at VT323 1.2rem, right-aligned tabular dates, each row a 44px link: system, usability and interaction in r3.
(e) Status gets a board of its own, 'This page' above the fold, values beside labels: system, interaction and usability in r3.
(f) Setup as an amber ring stop on the line, not an amber-edged box: system and skeptic in r3.
(g) Board under the box on the phone: soul and usability on the landing panel.
(h) The lit wire feeding the board, with the rail lit only from now to next: skeptic and system in r3, from the lineage's own Departures, Printed.
(i) Lately added kinds tied to their kind colour: style in r3.
(j) The Kind field as a text field with suggestions: interaction and usability in r3.
(k) A Late filter on To do: usability on the landing panel.
(l) A written type scale with clear steps, and labels one step lighter rather than smaller: type in r3 and on the landing panel.

briefs.avoids:
It answers the costume charge (soul, style, system, skeptic, interaction, type, usability and feedback on the landing panel): no tinted plate faces, no plum, and enamel only as 3px stubs and rings. It answers 'the soul sits only in the corner board' (soul): 'plan' gets the full halo and a pool from below, the board is wired to her line, and Status and Plans get tubes that draw their own data. It answers 'inner pages close to a generic dark dashboard' and 'the line thins out away from Home' (style, system, feedback, skeptic): every page head carries the line's stub and figure, and Ideas, Status, Settings and the right column of Home all hang from a steel rail with ring stops. It answers 'the right column out-weighs the left' (skeptic): the board is the only lit thing there, and Lately added is matte. It answers 'Status is the flattest page' (system): it gets a board and a dial. It answers 'small board rows' (usability, system), 'amber warning bar on setup' (skeptic), the long sight line from label to value (usability), the board falling far down the phone page (soul, usability) and the Kind field's unset look (interaction, usability). It also avoids the lineage's past failures: no hazard stripe, no number discs, no yellow tiles, no full-length lit rail (system's glare charge on Printed), no amber-boxed date pills, and no three-column squeeze.

What it gives up to make room: the three enamel key faces (the 67% green-share figure they bought was fragile anyway); the boxed setup notice; Status's three flat cards and its stand-alone spend tube; the plum Ideas colour; Plans' plain text summary head, which is replaced by the board; and the separate radar caption on Ideas.
briefs.title: 'Give Vera something to *plan*.' Not tried yet. It keeps what the panels liked in each of the two strongest families. Like 'Tell Vera what to plan.' (heat b's unanimous best), it names who hears you and makes the box's job an instruction to write, with the 4-letter lit job word last, where the eye stops. Like 'What's our plan?' (heat a's best), it is warm and open. It also avoids each family's faults: it cannot be read as 'show me our plan' (heat b's charge against 'What's our plan?'), cannot be answered 'no' (unlike 'Anything to plan?'), and does not presume a plan already exists (unlike 'Tell Vera our plans.'). 'Something' covers a weekend, a reminder, an idea or a wish alike, which is FamilyDB's whole job. On her line, it is the first stop handing her a departure to schedule. At 2.75rem it fits one desktop line, and it wraps after 'something' on a 390px phone with 'to plan.' kept together (a non-breaking space between them). The full stop sits in the ink text node after the lit span, which fixes the stray-period fault judges found in 'Tell Vera our plans.'

reading:
The departures line's judges love its structure and its usefulness. Vera's line runs down the left, with the box as the first stop. The 'usually Plans / To do / Ideas' hints tell a newcomer where things go. The lit 'Continue with Vera' terminus, the dot-matrix departure board with leader dots, the right-set dates and To do's margin times with a lit Now ring complete it. On the landing panel that gave interaction 8.5, usability 8.5 and type 8 ('the best typesetting on the panel'), with 0 small targets and the clearest sight line. Its mean was 7.58, about level with Desk Terminal, Joined's 7.54.

What sank it is narrow and keeps coming back. First, the enamel-tinted starter plates: teal, denim and especially a muddy plum. Every one of the eight lenses called them costume, and their 12% other-neon was the highest of the finals. Second, the soul sits only in the corner board: 'plan' has little halo, and there is no greeting pool. Third, away from Home the page becomes a tidy generic dark dashboard, because the line language thins out on Ideas, Plans and Status, and the right column of Home is a plain list.

The lineage's history repeats the warning. Night Timetable sank on transit costume (hazard stripe, number discs, yellow tiles). Departures, Posted sank at 89% green and a board that out-glowed the box. Printed was faulted for a fully lit rail and amber-boxed date pills.

What would make it win: keep the bones and the usability lead. Turn the enamel into neutral slate keys with 3px destination stubs and page icons. Give the question the original's E1 halo and a pool lit from below. Wire the board to her line, so the rail is lit only from now to next. Then carry the station's two devices, the line with ring stops and the lit board, onto every inner page. The main camp has proven structures for that: Joined's contents rail and spend dial for Status, Quote Board's figure head on every page, and Backlit Plate's four-week trace as the board's foot. Those make the system hold on Plans, To do, Status and Settings, where judges said it faded.
